name: Metallicdramon
main_effect:
[On Play] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ all of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) Then, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 5 or less. If no Digimon is deleted by this effect, none of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon can digivolve until the end of your opponent's turn.
[Opponent's Turn] While you have a Tamer in play, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.).
